meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在你遇到容器化代理系统故障时,按技能步骤引导排查:查看日志、检查会话数据库、确认挂载配置,并针对重复实例、认证失败等常见问题给出修复命令;也会解释容器系统各部分如何连接。
howto.when: 当系统出问题(如容器失败、认证报错等)或你想了解容器系统原理时,Claude 会使用此技能排查。

say.text: 我的容器不回复消息,帮我看下哪里出错了。
say.note: Claude 会让你查日志和会话数据库。

say.text: 容器一启动就退出,agent 没有回复,怎么排查?
say.note: Claude 会引导查看容器退出码和错误输出。

say.text: 出现认证 401 错误,可能是什么原因?
say.note: 将检查 secret 模式与 OneCLI 网关。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through debugging the containerized agent system: checking logs, inspecting session DBs, verifying mounts, fixing common issues such as duplicate instances and auth failures, and explaining how the system is wired.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the system misbehaves (e.g., container failure, auth errors) or when you want to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: My container isn't replying. Help me find the error.
say_en.note: Claude will have you check logs and session DBs.

say_en.text: Container exits immediately with no agent reply. How do I troubleshoot?
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through exit codes and stderr logs.

say_en.text: I'm getting a 401 auth error. What could cause it?
say_en.note: Claude will check secret mode and the OneCLI gateway.
